caveat: CELL-REPRESENTATIVE POINT SETS ARE HEURISTICALLY COMPLETE.  Every load reported here is EXACT for its point (integer arithmetic end to end), and every disjointness / core-freeness / containment check is exact.  But maximality of the load over ALL of [0,s]^2 rests on the representative construction (support-square vertices + pairwise edge intersections, nudged by +-1e-5 in 8 directions, reduced to inclusion-maximal membership patterns), NOT on a proof. certified_lower is a lower bound on tau_2(0) CONDITIONAL on that completeness.
